question: The part of a country's government responsible for its legal system
solution: An independent judiciary is essential for a fair democracy. देश की न्यायपालिका या कानूनी व्यवस्था संभालने वाला अंग।

question: In a lively, cheerful, and self-confident manner
solution: He walked jauntily into the room, whistling a tune. पूरे आत्मविश्वास और प्रसन्नता के साथ किया गया कार्य।

question: A military group that rules a country after taking power by force
solution: After the coup, the country was governed by a military junta. सेना के अधिकारियों का समूह जो बलपूर्वक शासन चलाता है।

question: A person or thing believed to bring bad luck
solution: I don't want to say we will win, I don't want to jinx it. जिसे मनहूस या बदकिस्मती लाने वाला माना जाए।

question: A person who rides in horse races, especially as a profession
solution: The jockey wore colorful silks during the race. घुड़दौड़ में भाग लेने वाला पेशेवर घुड़सवार।

question: The profession of collecting and writing news for media
solution: Investigative journalism uncovered the corruption scandal. अखबारों या मीडिया के लिए समाचार तैयार करने का पेशा (पत्रकारिता)।

question: The science or philosophy of law
solution: He is an expert in Islamic jurisprudence. कानून के सिद्धांतों और उसके दर्शन का अध्ययन (न्यायशास्त्र)।

question: Cheerful and friendly in manner
solution: Our host was a very jovial man who made everyone laugh. वह व्यक्ति जो स्वभाव से बहुत खुशमिजाज और मिलनसार हो।

question: To cross streets on foot carelessly
solution: It is dangerous and often illegal to jaywalk in busy cities. सड़क पर यातायात के नियमों की परवाह किए बिना कहीं से भी पैदल पार करना।

question: A short journey made for pleasure
solution: We took a quick jaunt to the mountains over the weekend. मनोरंजन या मज़े के लिए की गई छोटी यात्रा।

question: To place things side by side for comparison or contrast
solution: The artist juxtaposed bright colors with dark shadows. तुलना करने के लिए दो चीज़ों को पास-पास या अगल-बगल रखना।

question: Special words and phrases used by particular groups of people, especially in their work
solution: I couldn't understand the legal jargon used in the contract. किसी विशेष पेशे या समूह की अपनी विशिष्ट शब्दावली।

question: A person who writes for newspapers and magazines
solution: The journalist interviewed the prime minister. वह व्यक्ति जो समाचार पत्रों या पत्रिकाओं के लिए लिखता है (पत्रकार)।

question: A group of citizens who hear evidence in court and decide if someone is guilty
solution: The jury reached a unanimous verdict of not guilty. अदालत में सबूतों के आधार पर फैसला सुनाने वाला नागरिकों का समूह।

question: A person employed to clean and maintain a building
solution: The janitor is responsible for the upkeep of the school. वह व्यक्ति जो किसी इमारत की साफ-सफाई और देखरेख (maintenance) करता है।

question: An extreme form of patriotism
solution: His jingoism made him support every war his country started. अपने देश के प्रति बहुत ही कट्टर और उग्र राष्ट्रवाद की भावना।

question: Relating to young people who are not yet adults
solution: He was sent to a juvenile detention center. किशोरों या कम उम्र के लोगों से संबंधित।

question: A person who has been in jail many times
solution: A jailbird is a person who is or has been repeatedly imprisoned. वह अपराधी जो बार-बार जेल जा चुका हो।

question: Having two contrasting or opposite sides; deceitful
solution: Janus-faced refers to being insincere or having two different characters. वह व्यक्ति जिसका चरित्र दोहरा हो या जिसके दो विपरीत पहलू हों।

question: An overwhelming force or institution
solution: A juggernaut is a huge, powerful, and overwhelming force. एक ऐसी अत्यंत शक्तिशाली शक्ति या संस्था जिसे रोकना बहुत कठिन हो।

question: A person who performs tricks with their hands to amuse people
solution: A juggler entertains people by keeping several objects in motion in the air. वह व्यक्ति जो हाथ की सफाई या चीज़ों को हवा में उछालकर करतब दिखाता है (कलाबाज़)।

question: An untidy collection of things
solution: The room was full of a jumble of old books and papers. चीज़ों का एक अव्यवस्थित और बेतरतीब ढेर।

question: The official power to make legal decisions and judgements
solution: The case falls outside the local court's jurisdiction. वह कानूनी क्षेत्र या सीमा जहाँ तक किसी अधिकारी या अदालत का अधिकार होता है (अधिकार क्षेत्र)।
